form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Freeze hint intake must tolerate legacy scalar source metadata without crashing.
build_freeze_form_inputs_from_latest_hint must not crash when latest_freeze_hint.json has source as a string.
Formulary data ZIPs must remain project-local under project_freeze_after_update/freeze_hint_intake.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must remain patch ZIP root metadata and must not be installed into project root.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.feature_title: Freeze Hint Source Shape Tolerance v1
form_inputs.known_warnings: This patch fixes a compatibility crash caused by legacy/data-only freeze hint records whose source field is a scalar string instead of an object.
form_inputs.notes: This is a narrow contract-level tolerance repair. It does not change GUI write behavior or project freeze-memory ownership.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Re-run the formulary data v2 validation and open New Local Freeze Entry.

CONTRACT_TEST_OK: freeze_hint_intake tolerates legacy scalar source metadata in latest_freeze_hint.json
